theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_cone_filling_in_subspace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < m → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → BoundaryVanishes X → IsCompact X.support → X.support ⊆ (V : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = X ∧ IsCompact Y.support ∧ Y.support ⊆ (V : Set (Euclid P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
